commands:
set -euo pipefail
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin:$PATH"
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_BRANCH=fe341a26f149be9f2452705cacc7a431389133fa
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 scripts/apply_chat_relay_tx_pacing_v2.py test
set +e
gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayTurnPacingTest --no-daemon > /tmp/relay-pacing-v2-red.log 2>&1
RED_RC=$?
set -e
test $RED_RC -ne 0
grep -F 'postWriteHoldMs' /tmp/relay-pacing-v2-red.log >/dev/null
python3 scripts/apply_chat_relay_tx_pacing_v2.py impl
rm scripts/apply_chat_relay_tx_pacing_v2.py
git diff --check
gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayTurnPacingTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayDownlinkPumpTest --tests pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.developerrelay.ChatRelayBackendTest --no-daemon
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_chatgpt_relay_live_call.py'
gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon
git add -A
git commit -m 'fix: account for blocking relay tx writes'
git push origin HEAD:agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_tx_pacing_v2_green=true
echo relay_tx_pacing_v2_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
